root_readme.demo:
SPOTYKACH SD CARD
==============================================

Format the card as FAT32 (up to 32 GB). Each folder here belongs to one engine;
open its README.TXT for the exact audio format that folder needs.

The firmware does NOT convert audio. A file in the wrong format is not rejected -
it is read as raw bytes and plays as noise. Check a card with:

    python3 scripts/sk_card.py verify /path/to/card

Add your own audio with:

    python3 scripts/sk_card.py convert --engine tape /path/to/card mysound.mp3

Folders:
  SK/B         granular   WAV, 32-bit IEEE float (WAV AudioFormat 3) or signed 16-bit PCM (WAV AudioFormat 1), STEREO, 48000 Hz
  tapes        tape       WAV, 32-bit IEEE float (WAV AudioFormat 3), MONO, 48000 Hz
  shuttle      shuttle    WAV, 32-bit IEEE float (WAV AudioFormat 3), MONO, 48000 Hz
  softcut      softcut    WAV, 32-bit IEEE float (WAV AudioFormat 3), MONO, 48000 Hz
  radio/0      radio      headerless RAW, signed 16-bit PCM, little-endian, MONO, 48000 Hz
  bard/0       bard       WAV, signed 16-bit PCM (WAV AudioFormat 1), MONO, any sample rate
  pstretch     pstretch   WAV, signed 16-bit PCM (WAV AudioFormat 1), MONO, any sample rate
  csound       csound     plain text
  chuck        chuck      plain text
  SK           platform   plain text

The audio on this card is synthesized placeholder content so that every engine
makes a sound out of the box. Replace it with your own.
